snippet.title: Drift Market - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Chaos fueled destruction is coming to Steam Q4 2026 💥

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3965650/Drift_Market 

Destroy supermarkets, fight absurd bosses, and turn your trolley into a weapon of mass destruction! Drift through chaotic stores as a furious mutant fruit and unleash over-the-top, physics-driven mayhem in this ridiculous smash ‘em up.

All socials: https://linktr.ee/driftmarketgame 

#Silly #Steam #IndieGame #DriftMarket
